==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{ForceCollection|card name|star=number of stars}}</nowiki></code>

Use this to cite cards from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''. The "star" parameter will generate the appropriate number (from 1 to 5) of stars. Using S will generate the word Special.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{ForceCollection|Battle Droid: C-3PO}}</nowiki></code>

{{ForceCollection|Battle Droid: C-3PO}}
<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{ForceCollection|Agen Kolar|star=2}}</nowiki></code>

{{ForceCollection|Agen Kolar|star=2}}
<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{ForceCollection|Luke Skywalker|star=S}}</nowiki></code>

{{ForceCollection|Luke Skywalker|star=S}}
